studies.title: Fresh Grain
studies.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: clean baseline for LCL trimetric game art style comparison.
Generate a BRAND NEW image from this written description. No prior image is an input. A careful original opaque painted game illustration, with handsome clearly constructed machinery and controlled fine analogue grain. Landscape16:9.

SCENE: a solemn futuristic provision hall, fixed elevated overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel view like a classic overhead RPG game. Continuous rectangular blue-grey stone floor fills foreground; NO horizon, sky, floating diorama or cinematic low camera. Back wall runs diagonally from upper-left toward mid-right, providing a readable three-quarter view of machine fronts and top surfaces.
Across back wall is a bank of FOUR sturdy rounded cream-enamel dispensers, each with a neat recessed amber-lit serving opening, a single projecting black tray with ONE small cream bowl, a small green status lens, coral banding and restrained believable screws/vents. Above them, a thick segmented cream supply conduit with coral joining collars; black ribbed hoses curve between pipe and modules. At the right end a separate slightly taller rounded service cabinet has its access panel open, showing orderly purposeful fittings. One technician stands there, hands at the panel, a compact tool trolley beside him.
FOUR waiting people in dark brown/charcoal coats with muted rust hoods/trim stand spaced along the foreground on four cream corner-bracket floor marks, each holding one small bowl. Fifth person is technician. Exactly FIVE people total, anatomically sound hands, faces simply and intentionally painted at gameplay scale. Same human scale throughout.
Large deep petrol-blue masonry piers frame the hall and divide its back wall. A narrow stair behind left piers rises to an upper walkway with a clean brass-dark railing. Along left wall: one dark wood bench and orderly shelf of spare cream bowls; partial matching bench near lower right. Sparse functional amber cage lamps on left and right piers. Quiet scene, no action or debris.

STYLE AND COLOUR: opaque volumetric digital painting with controlled fine irregular analogue grain, matte enough to be pleasant and subtly tactile. Cream rounded enamel machinery, dark ribbed hoses, petrol/blue-grey floor and masonry, muted coral functional graphics, small green lenses, warm amber task apertures and lamps. Dark comfortable exposure, warm light pools and restrained floor reflections against rich cool shadows. Cream remains cream rather than teal; no neon whole-scene lighting, no extreme orange grade. Original authored illustration, clean material volumes and purposeful simple details; NOT photorealism or generic polished 3D render. Grain belongs to image tone, not a damaged-material map. Avoid chunky faceted paint tessellation, embossed surface cells, crawling maze patterns, tiny fake text, excessive chips, engraved casing cracks, overgrown stipple, smeared faces, incoherent repeated fittings and AI microdetail. Sparse credible wear only. Keep surfaces calm enough to judge grain and future pen/rim treatment. No extra hatch drawing or bright cyan contour lines in this BASELINE.

PHYSICAL GRAPHICS: original simple coral circle over TWO stacked downward chevrons on one cream supply segment and the right service casing. Coral stripes only where useful, no brand logos. Display numbers01,02,03,04 clearly on four dispenser faces, no other tiny words.

ACTUAL SCREEN HUD, independent of world: crisp compact dark charcoal clipped-corner panels with thin ivory-white rules and coral accents, exact clean readable lettering, no grain/no glow.
Top-left compact panel: original white circle over two downward chevrons beside three small coral horizontal bars; text "THE LINE", beneath coral "PROVISION".
Top-right small dark panel with white spanner icon, "SERVICE", underneath "MANUAL ACCESS".
Bottom-left row of four SEPARATE small dark clipped panels: small white circle/chevrons and numbers "01", "02", "03", "04"; fourth outlined/accented coral, others thin white.
Bottom-right small compact dark panel with two coral diagonal bars and "ALLOCATION ACTIVE".
HUD takes modest space and retains wide playable floor. No additional labels, watermarks, reference thumbnails or borders.

The objective is a CLEAN fresh Grain-style baseline with coherent geometry, readable five people and four serving modules, dark petrol/cream/coral/amber mood, subtle grain and crisp contrasting HUD. This is a fresh reconstruction from prose, not a new edit of a degraded image.
studies.lineage: Fresh text-only generation; no raster parents
studies.observations: Cleaner and more coherent than the inherited raster chain: calm machine volumes and no dense maze-like engraving. The recreation changes the old set to four tall individual dispensers, larger people and a revised compact HUD layout. Fine grain shares space with painted material mottling; some casing chips and simplified hands remain. It is a new baseline awaiting review, not a pixel-exact restoration or an automatically accepted replacement for original Grain.

studies.title: Ink + Rim
studies.lineage: One direct edit of fresh text-only baseline; no older raster parents
studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Input 1 is the edit target and the only raster reference. Create a restrained drawing-and-light variant of this EXACT fresh LCL provision hall image. Keep its camera, crop, aspect ratio, geometry, scene layout, machinery shapes and all five people's positions, proportions, clothing, poses and held bowls. Keep four serving modules with four projecting trays and four bowls, labels01–04, green status lenses, physical circle/chevrons emblems, cream supply pipe/coral collars, hoses, open service panel and trolley, benches, spare bowls, pier lamps, stairs and floor brackets unchanged.
Preserve exact petrol/blue-grey, cream, coral and amber palette, dark comfortable mean exposure, existing modeled shading, warm light locations, materials and fine analogue grain.

ONLY ADD these two restrained but perceptible treatments to the painted WORLD:
NIB: thin interrupted dark pen-like contours and a few short authored strokes, selectively at machinery seams, joints, hose curves, coat creases and pier edges. Occasional very sparse hatch accents follow the form. Keep large cream, floor and shadow fields calm. No global heavy outlines, dense crosshatching, maze-like engraving, artificial surface cells, cracks or added wear.
RIM: occasional short narrow muted cyan/petrol-blue glints along a few existing cool-facing machine and architectural edges, plus modest amber glints on existing warm-facing edges. They should sharpen selected forms, with quiet gaps between them. Do not continuously outline every object; no neon glow, new lamps, flood lighting, extra saturated orange grading or altered exposure.

Keep the ACTUAL SCREEN HUD absolutely unchanged: identical clean readable words, number tiles, icons, compact charcoal panel shapes, white/coral marks and placement. Exempt HUD from grain, pen treatment, glow and coloured edge effects. No new UI panels or labels.
No additional objects, changed fittings or fake microdetail. This image tests the user's preferred Nib and Rim qualities together against the clean baseline. Do NOT add undecided Chroma or Engraved treatments. Return the same landscape composition, changed only through selective ink accents and small coloured edge highlights.
studies.observations: Retains the new baseline's camera, five people, four tray bowls, machine arrangement, palette and readable HUD. Dark contour accents sharpen coats, hose folds and seams; fine cyan edges appear on piers, selected machine corners and floor joints, with amber edges on warm-facing rails and trays. Some glints run longer than the intended short accents and highlights/floor reflections read slightly brighter. The pen change is subtle and outlines are more polished than freely sketched. Existing material mottling/chips persist; this is one direct edit, not an artifact-free promise.
